description: State Rep Natalie Price (D) was at the Royal Oak town hall Thursday along with activist groups to inform concerned residents about ICE. The theme was mutual aid networks and how to build the infrastructure to keep members of the community informed and aware.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Natalie Price for State Senate
title: Royal Oak town hall on ICE instructs community members to form 'mutual aid' networks — Natalie Price for State Senate
